workload_summary: Primary workload: hybrid real-time alerting + customer support reranker. Mix of short-latency chat calls (~40 tokens) and occasional long generation analytics (~400-700 tokens). Peak concurrency tied to market micro-events (300-600 QPS). Requirements: p95 latency target 80-150ms for short requests, end-to-end SLOs for combined workloads ~200ms. Cost sensitivity: unit per-token margins are small; looking for 40-60% savings from batching + quantization + cache. Must preserve reranking quality within ~2% nDCG drop. Routing: want region-aware routing, fallback to cheaper quantized variants when capacity constrained.
perf_req_summary: Benchmark requests: full Redwood perf suite on Dedicated pool using NeoQuant prompt corpus. Metrics required: p50/p90/p95/p99 generation latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, KV cache hit/miss rates, batching efficiency (tokens per batch), tail latency under simulated burst traffic, quality deltas (nDCG/accuracy) between fp16 and quantized variants. Also request cost model per million tokens and suggested batch sizing + cache TTL to meet p95 SLO while minimizing GPU-hours. Will evaluate automated batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize and want example config to reproduce results in their staging VPC.
